Onyxia's Lair is a level 80 raid dungeon located in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. It is home to Onyxia, the brood mother of the black dragonflight.
Onyxia's Lair was originally a level 60, 40-player raid dungeon, one of two that were available upon release of World of Warcraft (the other being Molten Core). It was re-tuned as a level 80 raid dungeon in patch 3.2.2 in honor of World of Warcraft's 5-year anniversary. Like all other Wrath of the Lich King raid dungeons, it has both 10-man and 25-man modes.

Onyxia's Lair was originally a level 60, 40-player raid dungeon, one of two that were available upon release of ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' (the other being [[Molten Core]]).{{ref web|url = http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/news/wow-news2004.html|title = Old News 2004|accessdate = 2009-08-27|author = Helcon|date = 11/08/2004|work = '''World of Warcraft Open Beta Client Now Available HERE!'''|publisher = [[Blizzard Entertainment]] |language = English|quote =

Like all other ''[[Wrath of the Lich King]]'' raid dungeons, it has both 10-man and 25-man modes.{{ref web|url = http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/underdev/onyxia20.html|title = The Brood Mother Returns|accessdate = 2009-08-27|work = Under Development|publisher = [[Blizzard Entertainment]] |language = English|quote =}} ==Background== Onyxia built the lair. The entrance to the lair was carved to look like the maw of the broodmother herself, with its inner pathway being magma-lined and the ground cracked, glowing with fire from beneath. The arching stone ceiling groans and shifts, creating constant rockfalls. The walls spill lava where the heat can't be contained.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 148 ===World of Warcraft=== {{Wow-section}} Onyxia is the daughter of the mighty Black Aspect, [[Deathwing]], and sister of the scheming [[Nefarian]], Lord of Blackrock Spire. Whereas her father favors brute force, and her brother creates twisted abominations to carry out his will, Onyxia prefers subtle manipulation, and delights in meddling in the political affairs of mortals, using her charm and power to influence such delicate matters between the different races to her own ends. Some believe that Onyxia has even assumed an alias once used by her father - the title of the royal House Prestor. Most recently, she very nearly succeeded in destroying the political structure of [[Stormwind]] in the guise of [[Katrana Prestor]], before being unmasked by [[Marshal Windsor]] and fleeing to her lair: a fiery cave below the [[Dragonmurk]], a dismal swamp located within Dustwallow Marsh. There she is guarded by her kin, the remaining members of the insidious black dragonflight.[http://us.battle.net/wow/en/zone/onyxias-lair/ Onyxia's Lair] ===The Comic=== {{Comic-section}} After Onyxia's treachery was revealed and kidnapped [[Anduin Wrynn|Prince Anduin]], [[Varian Wrynn|King Varian Wrynn]] and a group of [[Alliance]] [[adventurer]]s launched an assault on the lair. After mounting an expedition, the two halves of Varian faced the black dragon broodmother, whose errant miscast of magic made him whole again. The fearsome battle required the blades and magic of many brave fighters.{{Ref WoWCodex|108}} The black dragon spewed her magma from the air above and sent her many whelplings at the heroes on the ground, and many of them were slain by the whelps. Onyxia was ultimately decapitated by Varian himself and her head was brought back to [[Stormwind City]] to be hung from the gates. After her death, [[Broll Bearmantle]] summoned roots from the ground to seal the lair's entrance and to kill her unhatched progeny.''[[Conflicting Loyalties]]'' Days later, [[Garona]] reopened the lair and was eventually found by her uncle [[Maraad]], who had been searching for her since the day he learned she was born.''[[World of Warcraft: The Comic]]'' - Issue 21: ''[[Secrets (comic)|]]'' ===Cataclysm=== {{Cata-section}} By the time of the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]], although Onyxia was dead, her brood was still present at her lair. Wishing to take his revenge on those who destroyed his [[Stonemaul Ruins|village]], the [[ogre]] [[Brogg]] tasked an [[adventurer]] to plant his [[:Stonemaul Banner]] at the entrance to that cave and to kill anyone who answered.[[Challenge to the Black Flight]] ===Exploring Azeroth=== {{Novel-section}} Following the [[Fourth War]], [[Rexxar]] and [[Zekhan]] visited the lair. ==Geography== File:VZ-Onyxia's Lair.jpg ==Dungeon denizens== [[File:Onyxia's Lair boss.jpg|thumb|250px|The only boss in Onyxia's Lair.]] *{{RaceIcon|Onyxia}} [[Black dragonflight|Black]] [[dragon]]s (one, [[Onyxia]]) *{{RaceIcon|SpawnBlack}} [[Black dragonflight|Black]] [[dragonspawn]] *{{RaceIcon|WhelpBlack}} [[Black dragonflight|Black]] [[dragon whelp]]s {| class="darktable" |- !
